text:
anika: Heads-up — we need an EBS IOPS/snapshot throughput bump for the upcoming GPU fleet migration next week. planning to restore ~180 TB across ~220 volumes concurrently. :rotating_light:

raj: Can you add numbers? are these io1/io2? region?

anika: io2 Block Express preferred for a few db-like volumes, most are gp3 currently. target region: us-west-2. rough ask: raise snapshot create throughput to 600 MB/s and per-volume IOPS to 50k for 40 volumes, plus baseline 10k for remaining gp3 volumes.

maria: sounds big. when's the migration window? we should schedule off-peak.

anika: migration kicks on Mon 03:00 PDT, expected 8h window, but restore will be bursty first 90m. need quota in place before then.

devops-larry: I'll open the AWS support case unless someone else already did. we need: account id, exact region, list of volume types/counts, and justification (burst restore for test -> prod cutover).

anika: account: 998877665544, region: us-west-2, volumes: 40 io2 BE (50k iops requested), 180 gp3 volumes (avg 6k iops), total transfer ~180 TB. justification: cross-region fleet migration for dedicated GPU cluster to meet capacity needs and avoid customer impact.

ops-oncall: any mitigation plan if quota not approved in time? can we stagger restores or use temporary instance types with local NVMe?

raj: we can stagger by AZs and throttle restores. also could pre-warm snapshot restores to S3/GCS then stream, but that adds cost/time.

maria: suggestion: ask for lower immediate increase (e.g., 300 MB/s snapshot throughput and 30k IOPS for 20 volumes) and request expedited review for full spike. AWS sometimes approves partial quickly.

anika: good call. let's do staged request. devops-larry, please include expedited flag and ask for partial first-approve + follow-up.

devops-larry: opening now. putting case notes here: ```Service: EBS Quotas
Account: 998877665544
Region: us-west-2
Requested increases:
- Snapshot throughput: 600 MB/s (preferred) / please approve 300 MB/s immediately
- io2 Block Express IOPS: 50,000 for 40 volumes (request 20 volumes @30k immediate)
- gp3 baseline IOPS: 6,000 for 180 volumes (5000 baseline request)
Reason: bulk restore for GPU fleet migration (180 TB). Critical to avoid prolonged downtime during cutover.
Timeframe: need initial approval before Mon 03:00 PDT (48h preferred)
```

cloud-bot: Support case created: AWS Case ID 12345678901234. Status: opened. Priority: high. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=12345678901234

ops-oncall: thanks. tagging @aws-support-channel and @sre to monitor. if we don't see approval by EOD, we'll throttle restores and move noncritical volumes to background window.

raj: also check snapshot concurrency limits and SSM API throttles — some restore tooling uses DescribeSnapshots heavily. add that to the case.

anika: added in case notes. thanks team. will update if timelines change. :thumbsup:
